profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Trane Technologies

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
• Developed and trained object detection and image classification models using Python and Google’s TensorFlow.  
• Implemented transfer learning techniques with a pre-trained convolutional neural network to address small sample sizes.  
• Collaborated with faculty and peers to enhance research methodologies and outcomes.

positions.title: Supply Chain Intellegence Intern
positions.description:
• Utilized Microsoft Visual Studio, Microsoft SQL Server, Tortoise SVN,
and Amazon Redshift SQL to address pain points, such as table load
tracking/error handling, in our supply chain.
• Project lead in which I and 2 other interns attributed the entirety all of
Colony’s active products (Approx. 6 million) then created a plan to
initiate implementation. This project was then presented to Colony’s
executive staff.

positions.title: Tech Writing  - Intern
positions.description:
• Team Lead of 13 IT interns in a summer project in which we tracked
and analyzed the security of a set of files as we followed them through
our IT infrastructure. We then presented our findings to CDW’s
executive staff.
• Improved the efficiency of our Java based applications using Jenkins,
IBM Rational Application Developer for WebSphere and SQL.
• Documented various roles and standards throughout our department.

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
• Utilized presentation design, advertisement design, video editing, and
social media education in the aim to assist realtors in everyday tasks
as well as creating a 500+ page training manual for incoming realtors.

positions.title: Customer Solutions Intern
positions.description:
•  Interacted with external and internal customers to correct erroneous
supply chain information through phones, email, chat, and a DOS
based system.
